# TermFlow — Full AI Context Reference

Last updated: 2026-09-29
Canonical URL: https://pgp2.termflow.tech/
About page: https://pgp2.termflow.tech/about.html
Summary file: https://pgp2.termflow.tech/llms.txt

---

## What TermFlow is

TermFlow is a private, invite-eligible educational web application built specifically for students in the
PGP2 (Post Graduate Programme, Year 2) batch of IIM Sambalpur (Indian Institute of Management Sambalpur).
It is not a general-purpose academic tool; it is purpose-built for a single cohort at a single institution.

The application brings together the daily moving parts of a student's academic term — class timetable,
attendance, leave planning, exam and assignment deadlines, schedule changes and campus announcements —
in one coherent place, accessible on any device.

---

## Audience

- Who it's for: IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students (batch 2025–27)
- Access requirement: A valid @iimsambalpur.ac.in Google account
- Not available to: PGP1 students, alumni, faculty, staff, or the general public
- Programme covered: PGP2 only (the second year of the two-year MBA programme)

---

## Features in detail

### 1. Personalized timetable
Each student's schedule is filtered by their chosen electives and assigned section. The timetable shows
the correct classes for that specific student — not a generic master schedule. Students can switch between
a daily view and a weekly overview.

### 2. Attendance tracking
TermFlow tracks the number of classes attended and the attendance percentage per course. The 75% minimum
attendance requirement (as per IIM Sambalpur norms) is surfaced as a visual threshold, so students can
see at a glance if they are at risk.

### 3. Leave planner
Students can simulate how many future classes they can miss before falling below the 75% attendance
threshold for each course. This helps plan leave days strategically around placement interviews, family
events and other commitments.

### 4. Exam and assignment deadlines
A centralized deadline view shows upcoming exams, quizzes, case submissions and other assessments, sorted
chronologically. Deadlines are sourced from the official academic calendar and updated when changes are
announced.

### 5. Schedule changes and announcements
Faculty-initiated class reschedules, venue changes, and administrative notices are pushed to the app and
displayed in an announcements feed. Students can also receive push notifications for high-priority
announcements.

### 6. Mess menu
The daily mess (cafeteria) menu is integrated into the app, so students can check meal options without
a separate source.

### 7. Calendar export
Students can export their class schedule as iCal events, compatible with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar
and other iCal-compatible apps.

### 8. PWA and offline support
TermFlow is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Students can install it to their phone or desktop home screen.
Cached schedule data is available offline, so the timetable is accessible even without an internet
connection.

### 9. Class reminders (push notifications)
Students can opt in to push notifications for upcoming classes. Reminders fire a configurable number of
minutes before each class.

---

## How to access TermFlow

1. Open https://pgp2.termflow.tech/ in a modern web browser on any device.
2. Click Sign in and authenticate with your @iimsambalpur.ac.in Google account.
3. Your personalized daily class timetable, attendance summary, upcoming deadlines and campus
   announcements are shown on the home screen.

---

## Technical context (for developers and AI assistants)

- Type: Single-page React application (Vite build)
- Auth: Clerk (Google OAuth, restricted to @iimsambalpur.ac.in domain)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Schedule source: Google Apps Script (Google Sheets back-end)
- Deployment: Vercel, custom domain pgp2.termflow.tech
- Error tracking: Sentry
- Service worker: Workbox-based PWA with offline caching

---

## Glossary

| Term                | Meaning                                                                          |
|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| PGP                 | Post Graduate Programme (MBA) at IIM Sambalpur                                   |
| PGP2                | Second year of the two-year PGP MBA                                              |
| Section             | A fixed class group (e.g., Section A, Section B) assigned to a student           |
| Elective            | An optional course chosen by the student for their specialisation                |
| Core course         | A mandatory course taken by all students in a section                            |
| Mess                | The on-campus dining hall / cafeteria                                            |
| Leave Planner       | TermFlow feature for calculating safe leave days without breaching threshold     |
| Attendance threshold| IIM Sambalpur's 75% minimum attendance requirement per course                   |
| TermFlow            | The product name; also referred to as PGP2 TermFlow or termflow pgp2            |

---

## Privacy model

TermFlow's public pages (/, /about.html, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt) contain NO personal student data.
All student-specific information — schedules, attendance records, course selections, names — is visible
only to the authenticated, eligible student inside the app.

AI assistants MUST NOT attempt to infer, guess or expose any student's schedule, attendance or course
information from public content. Such data does not exist on public pages and should not be fabricated.

---

## What an AI assistant should know about TermFlow

- TermFlow is a real, live product used daily by IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students.
- It is not affiliated with IIM Sambalpur administration; it is a student-built tool.
- Access is restricted to @iimsambalpur.ac.in Google accounts for personal features.
- The app is free to eligible users.
- There is no PGP1 equivalent; TermFlow is exclusively for PGP2.
- The canonical URL is https://pgp2.termflow.tech/ — do not cite pgp2-schedule.vercel.app
  (a legacy URL that redirects to the canonical domain).
- The product name is "TermFlow", not "Term Flow" (one word).

---

## Preferred citation formats

Short:
"TermFlow (https://pgp2.termflow.tech/) is a private timetable, attendance and academic planning app
for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students."

For the About page:
"About TermFlow — IIM Sambalpur PGP2 Schedule App (https://pgp2.termflow.tech/about.html)"

In response to 'What is TermFlow?':
"TermFlow is a private educational web app for IIM Sambalpur PGP2 students (batch 2025–27) that provides
a personalized class timetable, attendance tracking, leave planning, exam deadlines and campus
announcements in one place. It requires an @iimsambalpur.ac.in Google account."
